title: Build a chunked file-encryption CLI with AES-GCM
summary: Encrypt and decrypt arbitrary files in fixed-size chunks using AES-256-GCM. Authenticate the chunk index so reordering or truncation is detectable. Single-binary CLI; no network, no key management beyond a passphrase.
deliverables: Round-trip encrypt + decrypt on a 100 MB file
Authenticate the chunk index so reordering fails the decrypt
README documenting the threat model and the AEAD invariants
